measurement_contract.path: live mlx_vlm HTTP server timings; P0/U001 remained resident

classification.evidence: Neither exact gate/up launch fusion nor route-q4 plus fusion produced a sustained 100 TPS result in the shared live-worker lane; P1/P2/P4/P5 all remain below target.

bottleneck_evidence.simple_gate_up_fusion: Cannot remove MLA/attention or router selection; the measured direct-fusion precedent is only about +2% end-to-end.
bottleneck_evidence.interpretation: Route-only compression cannot supply the required 1.8x-2.6x gain. A credible 150-200 TPS attempt must be native route-major and also address selection, attention/MLA, persistence, and launch/synchronization overhead.

clean_room_arbitrage.interpretation: An 80 TPS result under a contended or wrapper-heavy lane could plausibly become roughly 90-100 TPS in an uncontended resident, but a new resident is not automatically faster; q4 candidates already showed lower TPS despite fewer bytes. Clean-room p50 is required before promotion and does not turn 80 into 150-200.

next_frontier: Do not run another quantization permutation. The only remaining credible Kimi path is a native route-major q4/g64 gate_up+down consumer with persistent buffers and complete-token parity; otherwise seal the Kimi physical Scar and return the GPU to Flash/Pulsar source-bound work.
claim_boundary: All staging residents were disposable and stopped after measurement. KIMI_P0_OPERATIONAL and KIMI-U001 remain live and unchanged.
